work_order.understanding: Issue #58 collects 18 follow-ups from PR #46. Re-checked against current main (line numbers in the issue have drifted; current ones are cited below). Reproduced by running the real function bodies: a repeated query key makes groupSectionFrom, activityFilterFrom and expenseFiltersFrom throw TypeError, and GroupPage/ActivityPage call them with raw Next.js searchParams before any error handling, so the route error boundary renders. Confirmed by reading the code on main: the failed /activity branch drops the ?group= scope from its chips and, when the groups read itself failed, from its retry; the group-page members excerpt says 'Hasn't joined yet' where ui.md and the members page say Placeholder; summary-card transfer lines never badge a departed seat although the Balances rows do; the expense-filter disclosure rotates both svgs and leaves a hidden checkbox focusable at >=sm; app/activity/loading.tsx sits above the session redirect so raw HTTP gets 200 plus skeleton; the UTC-labelled Timestamp cluster in components/ui-interactive.tsx has no production importer; calendar-day validation exists twice; the GroupPage docblock promises scriptless readers all four panels; members and activity skeletons give a scriptless reader no explanation. Dropped, with reason: the two ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM files[] findings (a work-order bookkeeping note about PR #46, the const is correctly placed, nothing to change) and the 'feed renders a UTC label' symptom (the live feed already uses components/timestamp.tsx; only the dead export and its test remain, so this is deletion, not a visible defect). No decisions were recorded in plan/brief.md. This is a replan: the last rejection asked for reproduction evidence and for a failed-load criterion QA can actually verify; both are answered below.
work_order.root_cause: Query parsers typed string | undefined receive string | string[] at runtime and call .trim() on it; the failed /activity branch was written as a separate code path that forgot the scope the success branch carries; the remaining findings are drift left by PR #46 (a duplicated parser, a dead module, a stale comment, a wording mismatch, a missing departed-seat label, a pre-existing boundary-above-guard route, a pre-existing silent no-JS skeleton).
work_order.approach: Fix each live finding at its root, and make the failed-feed behaviour testable by extracting it. (1) Add firstQueryValue in lib/groups/validation.ts and use it in all three filter parsers. (2) Move activityHref into lib/activity/queries.ts, add rawGroupScope there, and extract the failed /activity card into an exported ActivityFailed component in components/activity-feed.tsx that takes filter and groupId, renders FilterChips with the group scope preserved and a Retry link built by activityHref; the page passes scoped?.id ?? rawGroupScope(raw param), so a groups-read failure keeps the scope too. (3) Rebuild /activity with the session guard above an in-page Suspense (feed reads in an async child), delete app/activity/loading.tsx, mirroring the group page. (4) Label a departed transfer endpoint in the summary card with the existing Badge, unify the placeholder badge on 'Placeholder', scope the disclosure rotation to the chevron, take the checkbox out of the tab order at >=sm, and reword the docblock to the AC-16 contract. (5) Delete the dead UTC Timestamp cluster and its pinning tests, replacing them with one test that the module exports none of it. (6) Share one calendar-day validator between lib/dates.ts and lib/money/human-date.ts and document why the two date ladders differ. (7) Add the JavaScript-required noscript notice to the members and activity skeletons.

issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #35: 17 from the review, 1 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #46 (for #35) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.

> A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.
> 
> `lib/groups/validation.ts:165`
> 
> Evidence: lib/groups/validation.ts:165 does (raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Next.js delivers searchParams values as string | string[], so ?section=expenses&section=balances hands groupSectionFrom a string[], on which .trim() throws TypeError. GroupPage parses section at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:119 before the ledger try/catch, so the throw escapes to the route error boundary rather than rendering the expenses panel that AC-2/AC-10 require for malformed input.
> 
> Fix: Coerce before trimming, e.g. const value = (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Note activityFilterFrom and expenseFiltersFrom share the pattern; fixing only the new parser leaves the same crash on ?activity= and ?q=.

### The diff edits a file the work order does not name: lib/activity/queries.ts gains ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM, but work-order.json files[] lists only nine paths and this is not one of them.

> The diff edits a file the work order does not name: lib/activity/queries.ts gains ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM, but work-order.json files[] lists only nine paths and this is not one of them.
> 
> `lib/activity/queries.ts:56`
> 
> Evidence: work-order.json files[] names app/groups/[id]/page.tsx, app/groups/[id]/loading.tsx, app/groups/[id]/expenses/loading.tsx, components/group-page.tsx, components/timestamp.tsx, components/activity-feed.tsx, app/activity/page.tsx, lib/groups/validation.ts and lib/dates.ts (the four *.test.ts paths live under tests[], not files[]); gh pr diff 46 --name-only adds lib/activity/queries.ts, whose PR-branch line 56 is the new `export const ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM = 'group';` inside hunk @@ -41,6 +41,20 @@ with a comment block and no read, signature or endpoint change.
> 
> Fix: Name lib/activity/queries.ts in files[] as the supporting edit for the authorized app/activity/page.tsx ?group= scope (the constant sits beside ACTIVITY_FILTER_PARAM so the writer and reader cannot drift), or keep it and record the exception; no behavior change is needed.

### Failed-state filter chips on a scoped /activity feed drop the ?group= scope

> Failed-state filter chips on a scoped /activity feed drop the ?group= scope
> 
> `app/activity/page.tsx:127`
> 
> Evidence: app/activity/page.tsx:127 renders <FilterChips filter={filter} action="/activity" /> with no preserved prop, while the success branch at :154 passes preserved={{ [ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM]: scoped.id }}. FilterChips (components/activity-feed.tsx:142-156) submits only its own form plus hidden inputs from preserved, so clicking any chip on a failed scoped feed navigates to unscoped /activity. The retry link on the same screen does preserve the scope.
> 
> Fix: Pass the same preserved value to the failed-branch FilterChips: preserved={scoped === null ? {} : { [ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM]: scoped.id }}.

### Members-excerpt placeholder badge wording contradicts its own comment and the members page

> Members-excerpt placeholder badge wording contradicts its own comment and the members page
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:935`
> 
> Evidence: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:935 renders label 'Hasn't joined yet' under comment 'in the words the members page already uses', but the members page (components/groups-panels.tsx:616) renders <Badge>Placeholder</Badge>. Same seat, two names across one navigation.
> 
> Fix: Use label 'Placeholder' to match the members page, or correct the comment if the new wording is deliberate.

### lib/activity/queries.ts is edited by the PR but listed in neither the work order's files[] nor its tests[]: the ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM const lives there.

> lib/activity/queries.ts is edited by the PR but listed in neither the work order's files[] nor its tests[]: the ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM const lives there.
> 
> `lib/activity/queries.ts:56`
> 
> Evidence: gh pr diff 46 --name-only lists 14 files including lib/activity/queries.ts; work-order.json files[] names 9 paths without it and tests[] names only the four *.test.ts paths. The hunk is const-only (+14 lines: ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM = 'group' beside ACTIVITY_FILTER_PARAM, no read, signature or schema change). Required by the feature and correctly placed per the GROUP_SECTION_PARAM convention, so de minimis — but unlisted is unlisted.
> 
> Fix: Amend the work order's files[] to include lib/activity/queries.ts (const-only addition). Do not move the const: beside ACTIVITY_FILTER_PARAM is where the key convention says it lives, since the group page link writer and the /activity reader must share one spelling.

### Summary-card transfer lines name departed members without the 'No longer in the group' label AC-12 requires wherever a departed seat renders.

> Summary-card transfer lines name departed members without the 'No longer in the group' label AC-12 requires wherever a departed seat renders.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:401`
> 
> Evidence: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:401-409 renders transfers.slice(0, TRANSFER_LINES) via transferWords with no departed check, while transfers = simplifyDebts(ledger.balances) where balances still contains departed seats with non-zero nets (cf. the `shown` filter at :259-262 which exists precisely because balances includes them). The Balances tab rows do label them (:642-644). So a transfer involving a departed seat prints e.g. 'Bo owes you' in the summary with no badge, one screen above rows that carry it.
> 
> Fix: Apply the same currentIds check in the summary transfer lines (badge or parenthetical) or look up transfer endpoints against members the way the balance list does.

### GroupPage doc comment promises scriptless readers 'get all four' panels, contradicting the AC-16 contract this same PR establishes (skeleton plus JS-required notice, no ledger).

> GroupPage doc comment promises scriptless readers 'get all four' panels, contradicting the AC-16 contract this same PR establishes (skeleton plus JS-required notice, no ledger).
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:75`
> 
> Evidence: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:75: 'the panels are server-rendered, and a reader without JavaScript gets all four.' review.title: On a failed feed the raw ?group= uuid is carried into the chips and Retry even when the groups read succeeded and the id is not one of the viewer's groups.
review.detail:
On a failed feed the raw ?group= uuid is carried into the chips and Retry even when the groups read succeeded and the id is not one of the viewer's groups.

`app/activity/page.tsx:140`

Evidence: ActivityContent line 140: groupId={scoped?.id ?? rawGroupScope(rawGroup)}. If listActivityGroups succeeds, scoped is null for a stranger's uuid, but rawGroupScope still returns it, so ActivityFailed puts that uuid in the hidden group input and the Retry href. The success branch drops it (scoped === null gives preserved={}).

Fix: Use the raw fallback only when the groups read is what failed, for example track groupsFailed and write groupsFailed ? rawGroupScope(rawGroup) : (scoped?.id ?? null). Low impact: the scope is a filter, not an authorization, and the next successful load discards the id.

review.title: Moving the "Showing X only" line out of the header changes its spacing on the loaded screen: it was gap-2 under the title row and is now a gap-5 sibling of the feed.
review.detail:
Moving the "Showing X only" line out of the header changes its spacing on the loaded screen: it was gap-2 under the title row and is now a gap-5 sibling of the feed.

`app/activity/page.tsx:150`

Evidence: Before: <header className="flex flex-col gap-2"> held the title row and the scope line. After: the header is only the title row and ActivityContent's fragment is a child of <main className="... gap-5">, so the scope line sits 20px below the title instead of 8px. The work order's AC list does not mention it and the skeleton fallback reserves an h-6 block that no longer matches the old rhythm.

Fix: Keep the old 8px rhythm by wrapping the scope line and feed in a flex-col gap-2 / or give the scope line -mt-3; or accept it and say so in the PR description.
